t: This is the base of Citymapper, a British public transit app and mapping service. It shows transport options between any two locations in a supported city, usually with live timing. It covers all urban modes, including walking, cycling, driving and public transport. It is free to use, on a mobile app or on its website. Azmat Yusuf, a former Google employee, founded it and serves as its CEO. If you've ever checked the best route across London on your phone, this is the kind of tool you were using.
